name: Canon Quality Score (Canon Score)
status: Structured quality checklist. Weights and thresholds are author judgement; not validated against investment results. v1.2 was written after seeing 2021 bank data (in-sample).

conventions.boundary: A value exactly on a band boundary takes the higher band.
conventions.two_rows: If a company fits two rows, take the lower score.
conventions.aggregation: Sum of seven dimension scores (0-100); never averaged.
conventions.price_dependence: Dimensions 3 and 4 depend on the share price and trading; record the price date with every score.

sub.name: 3-year average ROE
bands: below 7%, or negative in any of last 3 years

sub.name: Capital adequacy (BFIs) / leverage (non-BFIs)
bands: CAR 11.5%-13%; moderate leverage with adequate cover
CAR below 11% at any point in 3 years; high leverage with weak cover

sub.name: Earnings quality, 5-year profit history
bands: no loss year; profit grew in 4+ of last 5 years
one loss year, or two flat/declining years
no loss year, but flat/declining in 3+ years

sub.name: Promoter holding stability and pledging (CDSC, 3 years)
bands: sharply declining, >50% pledged, or repeated insider selling
sub.missing_data: pledging not verified: score at most 4

sub.name: Related-party transactions and audit opinion
sub.bands: qualitative only in v1.2 (near full marks / near zero)

dimensions.name: Liquidity & Tradability
dimensions.note: Floors, not a measure of whether your own order can be filled; use Chapter 56's ADV rule.

dimensions.name: Valuation Reasonableness

sub.name: P/E vs sector median
bands: 0.8x or below (only if ROE >= sector median; else 6)

sub.name: P/B vs sector median
sub.bands: 'identical relative logic' to P/E; in-line = 5 and 1.1x-1.5x = 3 as applied in Chapters 64 and 83; top band 7 only if ROE >= sector median

dimensions.note: Only the sector median is scored; the company's own 5-year median is a cross-check.

sub.name: Revenue concentration
sub.note: Chapter 65 replaces this for hydropower (single NEA buyer).

sub.name: Loan growth vs system (lenders, from v1.2)
bands: more than 10 points faster or slower, or shrinking while system grows
adjustments: at a credit peak, >5 points faster than system scores 0
loans >5 points faster than deposits: drop one row
no verified system figure: at most 5

sub.name: Bonus-adjusted EPS growth, 5 years
bands: rose in 4+ of 5 years, no single-year swing >50%
rose in 2 of 5, or high volatility
rose in fewer than 2, or negative in 3+ years

sub.name: Consistency, 5 years
bands: paid every year; payout 30%-70% of distributable profit
paid 4 of 5, or payout very low/high

score_bands: Exceptional; core holding up to 6%-8% of equity sleeve

triggers: audit/related-party check scores 1 or less of 5

known_overlaps: About 25-30 of 100 points rest directly or indirectly on reported profit (ROE, earnings quality, EPS growth, dividend consistency, ROE gate on valuation).
comparability: Compare totals within a sector; cross-sector comparability is a design aim, not tested.

proposed_v1_3.status: proposed, not in force; never applies to the 1.2-P record
items: Year counting: compare each of last five years with the year before (six years of data)
Average daily turnover = 6-month traded value / NEPSE trading days, including zero-trade days
Missing data: unverified sub-component at most middle band; >20 points unverified = provisional
Record data cut-off and price date with every score

history: closed table gaps and overlaps, bonus-adjusted EPS, severe-red-flag override trigger with cap 54, aligned bands with Ch66, capped unverified pledging
lender loan growth vs system with credit-peak cap and funding check; valuation discount needs ROE >= sector median
